mapper.select: select us.id , us.create_time as appDateTime , a.name , a.create_time as createTime , a.limit_start_time limitStartTime ,a.limit_end_time limitEndTime ,a.apply_end_time applyEndTime ,a.limited , a.count , a.already_apply_count alreadyApplyCount ,a.id applyId , a.status status from t_user_apply us LEFT JOIN t_apply a on us.apply_id =a.id WHERE us.deleted = 0 and a.deleted = 0 and us.user_id = #{userId}
